title: Sub filtering takes the left value according to the byte pitch per pixel
summary: When rebuilding a Sub row, the current filtered byte is added to the corresponding byte on the left that has been reconstructed in the same row, and the result is modulo 256.
detail: The left distance is taken as the number of bytes of a full pixel and rounded up. The distance is 3 for 8-bit RGB and 1 for 1-bit grayscale.
boundary: Missing left-hand bytes at the beginning of the line are zeroed. The left value comes from the reconstructed data.
relevance: If the color channels are cyclically bit stringed, check which reconstructed byte the filter refers to.
